从情景偏好反馈中学习基于内核的 MDPLearning Kernel-Based MDPs from Episodic Preferential Feedback

Nikola Pavlovic
Cornell University
np.358@cornell.edu
&Sattar Vakili
MediaTek Research
Qing Zhao
Cornell University
摘要Abstract

人类反馈通常以偏好的形式出现，而不是经过校准的数字 奖励，从偏好反馈中激发强化学习， 称为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）。我们呈现 情景内核中仅偏好学习的严格理论研究 MDP。在每一集中，学习者从一个共同的开始部署两个策略 状态并接收一个二进制标签，指示哪个轨迹是 首选，由 Bradley-Terry-Luce 链接建模，其差异在于 累积（未观察到）奖励。在基于内核的奖励假设下 和过渡函数（最通用的模型之一，适合理论 分析）我们开发基于偏好的价值估计和置信集 适合剧集结尾的比较。我们 证明高概率的遗憾限制了该规模 剧集数量呈次线性关系，这意味着 学习到的策略的价值收敛于 即最优政策。Human feedback often arrives as preferences rather than calibrated numeric rewards, motivating reinforcement learning from preferential feedback, also referred to as reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF). We present a rigorous theoretical study of preference-only learning in episodic kernel MDPs. In each episode, the learner deploys two policies from a common start state and receives a single binary label indicating which trajectory is preferred, modeled by a Bradley–Terry–Luce link on the difference of cumulative (unobserved) rewards. Under kernel-based assumptions on the reward and transition functions (one of the most general models amenable to theoretical analysis) we develop preference-based value estimation and confidence sets tailored to end-of-episode comparisons.We prove high-probability regret bounds that scale sublinearly in the number of episodes, implying that the value of the learned policy converges to that of the optimal policy.

1 简介Introduction

仅使用基于偏好的反馈来优化顺序决策最近已成为一个重要问题Optimizing sequential decision-making using only preference-based feedback has recently emerged as an important problem(Wirth et al., 2017; Christiano et al., 2017)。在许多应用中，包括大型语言模型对齐. In many applications, including large language model alignment(Ouyang et al., 2022)、机器人技术和推荐系统中，人类发现比较选项而不是分配校准的数字分数是很自然的。偏好反馈通常比数字评级更可靠，即使信息量较少。由于人类反馈的成本很高，因此开发有效的方法变得至关重要，该方法可以学习接近最优的策略，同时最大限度地减少所需的偏好查询数量。这激发了对偏好反馈强化学习的研究，通常称为人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）。, robotics, and recommendation systems, humans find it natural to compare options rather than assign calibrated numeric scores. Preference feedback is often more reliable than numeric ratings, even if less informative. Since human feedback is costly, it becomes essential to develop efficient methods that can learn near-optimal policies while minimizing the number of preference queries required. This motivates the study of reinforcement learning from preferential feedback, commonly referred to as reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF).

在情景马尔可夫决策过程 (MDP) 的 RLHF 框架中，在每个情景中，学习者都会部署策略并接收偏好反馈，表明首选轨迹，而不是观察数字奖励。这种二元反馈通常使用 Bradley-Terry-Luce (BTL) 模型建模为伯努利随机变量，其中偏好的概率是通过将链接函数应用于累积奖励的差异来确定的。绩效是根据后悔来衡量的，后悔被定义为与最优策略相比的累积损失。关键的挑战是从每集的最小一位反馈中学习，其中轨迹级信号不提供有关每步信用分配的直接信息。In the RLHF framework for episodic Markov Decision Processes (MDPs), at each episode, the learner deploys policies and receives preference feedback indicating which trajectory is preferred, rather than observing numeric rewards. This binary feedback is typically modeled as a Bernoulli random variable using the Bradley-Terry-Luce (BTL) model, in which the probability of a preference is determined by applying a link function to the difference in cumulative rewards. Performance is measured in terms of regret, defined as the cumulative loss compared to the optimal policy. The key challenge is learning from minimal one-bit feedback per episode, where the trajectory-level signal provides no direct information about per-step credit assignment.

有几项工作研究了表格 MDP 中基于偏好的 RL，但是这些 即使对于小的状态空间，算法在计算上也很困难。Several works have studied preference-based RL in tabular MDPs, but these algorithms are computationally intractable even for small state spaces.Wu and Sun (2023)提供第一个计算高效的算法 对于线性 MDP 中基于偏好的 RL，通过以下方式实现接近最优的后悔 随机化来处理轨迹级反馈。然而，线性 MDP 假设是有限制性的。例如，provide the first computationally efficient algorithm for preference-based RL in linear MDPs, achieving near-optimal regret via randomization to handle trajectory-level feedback. However, the linear MDP assumption is restrictive. For example,Lee and Oh (2023)表明所需要的 特征维度可以随着状态空间的大小而缩放。基于内核 模型提供了一种自然的概括，可以捕获非线性结构，同时 仍然服从理论，并通过神经网络连接到神经网络 切线核showed that the required feature dimension can scale with the size of the state space. Kernel-based models offer a natural generalization that captures nonlinear structure while remaining amenable to theory, and connect to neural networks via the Neural Tangent Kernel(NTK, Jacot et al., 2018)。标准下的内核 RL 奖励反馈已被广泛研究. Kernel RL under standard reward feedback has been studied extensively(Yang et al., 2020; Chowdhury and Gopalan, 2019; Maran et al., 2024a, b)，并且亚线性遗憾最近才实现, and sublinear regret has only recently been achieved(Maran et al., 2024b).

1.1 主要结果Main Results

在这项工作中，我们开发了第一个在内核 MDP 中基于偏好的 RL 算法，该算法为 Matérn 系列中的所有内核实现了可证明的亚线性遗憾。我们的算法获得订单的累积遗憾In this work, we develop the first algorithm for preference-based RL in kernel MDPs that achieves provable sublinear regret for all kernels in the Matérn family. Our algorithm attains cumulative regret of order𝒪~​(K1−0.5​(βp−1)2/βp​(βp+1))\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\left(K^{1-0.5(\beta_{p}-1)^{2}/\beta_{p}(\beta_{p}+1)}\right), 其中, whereβp>1\beta_{p}>1是假设中定义的特征衰减参数is the eigen-decay parameter defined in Assumption2.2。此外，该算法可以用情节数的时间多项式来实现. In addition, the algorithm can be implemented in time polynomial in the number of episodesKK，从而为内核 MDP 中基于偏好的反馈提供了第一个计算高效的无遗憾算法。, thereby providing the first computationally efficient no-regret algorithm for preference-based feedback in kernel MDPs.

偏好反馈比行动级标量奖励反馈更具挑战性。与提供包含幅度和分布信息的连续信号的标量反馈不同，偏好反馈将整个事件的信息压缩为单个二进制比较。结果，幅度信息（奖励幅度）和细粒度时间信息（每步奖励分配）都会丢失。尽管如此，我们表明Preference feedback is substantially more challenging than action-level scalar reward feedback. Unlike scalar feedback, which provides continuous signals containing both magnitude and distributional information, preference feedback compresses the information from an entire episode into a single binary comparison. As a result, both amplitude information (reward magnitude) and fine-grained temporal information (per-step reward assignment) are lost. 在基于偏好的反馈下实现次线性后悔需要克服三个相互关联的技术挑战：（i）控制Achieving sublinear regret under preference-based feedback requires overcoming three interrelated technical challenges: (i) controlling the日志覆盖数log-covering number价值函数类，这取决于估计量的 RKHS 范数； (ii) 设计探索噪声，以引起足够的轨迹级探索，同时保持有效的覆盖参数； (iii) 仔细调整正则化和覆盖参数，以同时平衡偏差、方差和统计复杂性。of the value function class, which depends on the RKHS norm of the estimators; (ii) designing exploration noise that induces sufficient trajectory-level exploration while remaining amenable to efficient covering arguments; and (iii) carefully tuning regularization and covering parameters to balance bias, variance, and statistical complexity simultaneously.

1.2 技术挑战和贡献Technical Challenges and Contributions

我们在这里概述了三个主要技术挑战和相应的贡献，完整的技术细节推迟到第二节。We provide an overview of the three main technical challenges and corresponding contributions here, with full technical details deferred to Sec.4.

(i) 通过估计器范数界限控制对数覆盖数。(i) Controlling the log-covering number via estimator norm bound.

在核 MDP 中，置信边界取决于值函数类的对数覆盖数，而该数又与估计器的 RKHS 范数成比例。这是与线性 MDP 的根本区别，线性 MDP 的对数覆盖数仅是情节计数的对数In kernel MDPs, confidence bounds depend on the log-covering number of the value-function class, which in turn scales with the RKHS norms of the estimators. This is a fundamental difference from linear MDPs, where the log-covering numbers are only logarithmic in the episode count(Jin et al., 2020)。在轨迹级偏好反馈下，动作级内核强化学习中使用的定位参数. Under trajectory-level preference feedback, localization arguments used in action-level kernel RL(Maran et al., 2024a; Janz et al., 2020)，不再适用，天真的估计者可能会表现出快速增长的 RKHS 规范，导致过于保守的置信集。我们的方法通过使用正则化核逻辑回归从偏好中学习奖励分量来控制这种复杂性，并明确调整正则化以保持估计器范数（从而保持归纳函数类的覆盖数量）较小。, no longer apply, and naive estimators can exhibit rapidly growing RKHS norms, leading to overly conservative confidence sets. Our approach controls this complexity by learning the reward component from preferences using regularized kernel logistic regression, with the regularization explicitly tuned to keep the estimator norm (and thus the covering number of the induced function class) small.

(ii) 设计具有有效可覆盖样本路径的轨迹级探索。(ii) Designing trajectory-level exploration with efficiently coverable sample paths.

偏好反馈需要在轨迹级别进行探索，但无法应用确定性奖励，因为实现的轨迹在决策时是未知的。因此，我们通过可以在线注入的高斯过程扰动来使用随机探索。由于 GP 样本路径不属于由其协方差核引起的 RKHS 几乎可以肯定Preference feedback requires exploration at the trajectory level, but deterministic bonuses cannot be applied because the realized trajectory is unknown at decision time. We therefore use randomized exploration through a Gaussian process perturbation that can be injected online. Since GP sample paths do not belong to the RKHS induced by their covariance kernel almost surely(Kanagawa et al., 2018)，我们无法通过将随机估计量放入原始 RKHS 的球中来覆盖它。相反，我们使用高概率高斯覆盖集：尽管 GP 样本不是 包含在任何固定有限半径 RKHS 球中，它很有可能位于, we cannot cover the randomized estimator by placing it in a ball of the original RKHS. Instead, we use a high-probability Gaussian covering set: although a GP sample is not contained in any fixed finite-radius RKHS ball, it lies with high probability withinϵ\epsilon，在, inℓ∞\ell_{\infty}，适当放大的 RKHS 球, of a suitably enlarged RKHS ball(van der Vaart and van Zanten, 2008)。这使我们能够直接导出后 GP 扰动的覆盖范围。. This allows us to derive covering bounds for the posterior GP perturbation directly.

(iii) 调整正则化和覆盖参数以达到平衡 偏差、方差和复杂性。(iii) Tuning regularization and covering parameters to balance bias, variance, and complexity.

正则化在我们的工作中起着双重作用：它控制统计准确性（偏差和 方差）以及覆盖数字的复杂性。与线性值迭代不同Regularization plays a dual role in our work: it controls statistical accuracy (bias and variance) and also complexity via covering numbers. Unlike linear value iterationJin et al. (2020)，其中对数覆盖数只是多对数 在网格中, where log covering numbers are only polylogarithmic in the meshϵ\epsilon，内核 MDP 产生覆盖边界的多项式对数 （参见（, kernel MDPs yield polynomial log covering bounds (see (4））。这使得调优)). This makes tuningϵ\epsilon不平凡的： 太小会增加置信宽度，太大会增加错误指定 错误。我们调整正则化和覆盖网格non-trivial: too small inflates confidence widths, too large inflates misspecification error. We tune both the regularization and covering meshϵ\epsilon共同 在偏好反馈下保持置信界限有意义。jointly to keep confidence bounds meaningful under preference feedback.

这些成分共同产生了第一个基于偏好的内核 MDP 算法，具有可证明的亚线性遗憾。Together, these ingredients yield the first preference-based kernel MDP algorithm with provable sublinear regret.

1.3 相关工作Related Work

近年来，基于偏好的强化学习在 bandit 和 MDP 环境中都受到了极大的关注。在强盗设置中，对应于具有单一状态的退化情况，行动级别偏好（决斗强盗）已在各种奖励函数和偏好假设家族中得到了广泛研究In recent years, preference-based reinforcement learning has gained significant attention in both bandit and MDP settings. In the bandit setting, that corresponds to a degenerate case with a single state, action-level preference (dueling bandits) has been extensively studied across various families of reward functions and preference assumptions(Yue and Joachims, 2009; Ailon et al., 2014; Saha et al., 2021; Bengs et al., 2022; Wu et al., 2023; Verma et al., 2024; Kayal et al., 2025)222有关强盗决斗的文献非常多，请参阅The body of literature on dueling bandits is vast, seeBengs et al. 设计估计器To design the estimatorθ^k\widehat{\theta}_{k}对于状态-动作值函数，我们将使用内核逻辑岭回归器（参见等式。（for the state-action value function, we will use the kernel logistic ridge regressor (see eq.(7））（KLRR）。然而，正如 RL 应用中常见的那样，我们需要确保用于计算 KLRR 的轨迹集具有足够的信息（即探索性）。为了激励轨迹级探索，我们需要设计一个探索奖励来添加到))(KLRR). However, as is common in RL applications, we need to ensure that the set of trajectories used to compute KLRR is sufficiently informative (i.e. exploratory). To incentivize trajectory-level exploration, we need to design an exploration bonus to be added toθ^k\widehat{\theta}_{k}。利用轨迹级反馈促进探索的一个困难在于，常用的椭圆（确定性）奖励需要在每集开始时预先完全了解轨迹。如果不完全了解过渡动态，这显然是不可能的，为了克服这个问题，我们使用随机（线性）探索奖励. A difficulty in promoting exploration with trajectory-level feedback is that a commonly used elliptic (deterministic) bonus requires complete knowledge of the trajectory up front, at the beginning of each episode. This is clearly impossible without fully knowing the transition dynamics, and to overcome this issue, we use a randomized (linear) exploration bonus(Cassel et al., 2024; Shani et al., 2020)。 在基于内核的强化学习中，探索噪声来自高斯过程 (GP)。我们画. 将基于偏好的 RL 扩展到内核 MDP 引入了基于线性偏好的 RL 和具有动作级别奖励的内核 RL 中不存在的技术障碍。核心挑战是控制价值函数类的对数覆盖数，它直接决定置信区间的宽度，对于基于乐观的分析至关重要Extending preference-based RL to kernel MDPs introduces technical obstacles absent in both linear preference-based RL and kernel RL with action-level rewards. The central challenge is controlling the log-covering number of the value-function class, which directly determines the widths of confidence intervals and is essential for optimism-based analyses(Jin et al., 2020).

相关方法。Related approaches.

动作级内核 MDP 的当前技术水平The current state of the art for action-level kernel MDPs(Maran et al., 2024b)考虑空间划分，其中 Bellman 算子允许低误差、局部线性近似，并完全避免非参数函数族上的值迭代。同时considers space partitioning in which the Bellman operator admits a low-error, locally linear approximation and avoids value iteration over a nonparametric functional family altogether. WhileMaran et al. (2024b)尽管域划分在一系列平滑 MDP 中实现了令人印象深刻的无悔性能，但在轨迹级反馈中基本上不适用。转换的随机性阻止了预先确定将实现哪条轨迹（以及空间的哪一部分），从而排除了局部贝尔曼算子估计。此外，标准椭圆探索奖励无法因果计算；他们需要在情节开始之前了解整个轨迹。 与内核偏好学习相关的另一个研究方向是线性 MDP 中的轨迹级反馈学习。线性 MDP 中探索奖励的因果关系通过从轨迹协方差中采样高斯噪声来解决achieves an impressive no-regret performance for a wide family of smooth MDPs, domain partitioning is fundamentally unapplicable in trajectory-level feedback. The stochasticity of transitions prevents advance determination of which trajectory (and thus which part of the space) will be realized, precluding localized Bellman operator estimation. In addition, standard elliptic exploration bonuses cannot be computed causally; they require knowing the whole trajectory before the episode begins. An additional research direction relevant to preference learning with kernels is trajectory-level feedback learning in linear MDPs. Causality of the exploration bonus in linear MDP’s is adressed by sampling Gaussian noise from the trajectory covariance(Shani et al., 2020; Cassel et al., 2024)。线性 MDP 的探索只需要沿着. Exploration in linear MDPs requires exploration only alongdd方向，因此添加探索性噪声不会改变日志覆盖范围的顺序directions, hence the addition of the exploratory noise does not alter the order of the log covering bounds inJin et al. (2020).

5 结论Conclusion

我们研究了内核 MDP 设置中的偏好反馈并设计了亚线性后悔策略。我们方法的主要新颖之处在于新的 GP 特定覆盖范围的推导以及范数正则化器和覆盖网格的调整，以控制值函数类的覆盖数量，从而控制We study preference feedback in the kernel MDP setting and design a sublinear regret policy. The main novelty of our approach is the derivation of the new GP-specific covering bounds and the tuning of the norm regularizer and the covering mesh to control the covering number of the value function class and, hence, the confidence width of theQQ-function estimator.
是否后悔的界限Whether the regret bound of普罗斯托PROSTO能否使订单最优仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。域划分 方法can be made order-optimal remains an open question. Domain partitioning approaches(Janz et al., 2020; Valko et al., 2013)目前，它提供了内核 MDP 和上下文老虎机中顺序最优遗憾的唯一已知路径，与轨迹级反馈不兼容，因此需要一种根本不同的技术。, which currently provide the only known path to order-optimal regret in kernel MDPs and contextual bandits, are incompatible with trajectory-level feedback, so a fundamentally different technique would be required.

7 附录CAppendix C

在本节中，我们将围绕在内核 MDP 中考虑线性轨迹反馈设置和动作级反馈的作品中采用思想的难度添加更多技术性讨论。In this section, we add a more technical discussion around the difficulty of adapting the ideas from the works that consider linear trajectory-feedback setting and action-level feedback in kernel MDPs.

将当前方法扩展到内核 RL 偏好反馈存在困难。Difficulty of extending current approaches to kernel RL preference feedback.

将基于偏好的 RL 扩展到内核 MDP 引入了基于线性偏好的 RL 和具有动作级别奖励的内核 RL 中不存在的技术障碍。核心挑战是控制价值函数类的对数覆盖数，它直接决定置信区间的宽度，对于基于乐观的分析至关重要Extending preference-based RL to kernel MDPs introduces technical obstacles absent in both linear preference-based RL and kernel RL with action-level rewards. The central challenge is controlling the log-covering number of the value-function class, which directly determines the widths of confidence intervals and is essential for optimism-based analyses[Jin et al., 2020].

在线性 MDP 中，对数覆盖数在环境维度中以多项式有界，不随episode 数量增长，并且仅相对于覆盖参数呈现对数增长In linear MDPs, the log-covering number is bounded polynomially in the ambient dimension, does not grow with the number of episodes, and only exhibits logarithmic growth with respect to the covering parameterϵ\epsilon [Jin et al., 2020]。因此，覆盖网. Consequently, the covering meshϵ\epsilon可以设置为can be set to1/poly​(K)1/\text{poly}(K)当日志覆盖数仍然存在时while the log-covering number remains𝒪~​(1)\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(1)，保持后悔顺序不变。在内核设置中，情况有根本的不同。回想一下参数, leaving the regret order unchanged. In kernel settings, the situation is fundamentally different. 动作级内核 MDP 的当前技术水平The current state of the art for action-level kernel MDPs[Maran et al., 2024b]考虑空间划分，其中 Bellman 算子允许低误差、局部线性近似，并完全避免非参数函数族上的值迭代。同时considers space partitioning in which the Bellman operator admits a low-error, locally linear approximation and avoids value iteration over a nonparametric functional family altogether. WhileMaran et al. [2024b]尽管域划分在一系列平滑 MDP 中实现了令人印象深刻的无悔性能，但在轨迹级反馈中基本上不适用。转换的随机性阻止了预先确定将实现哪条轨迹（以及空间的哪一部分），从而排除了局部贝尔曼算子估计。此外，标准椭圆探索奖励无法因果计算；他们需要在情节开始之前了解整个轨迹。的工作achieves an impressive no-regret performance for a wide family of smooth MDPs, domain partitioning is fundamentally unapplicable in trajectory-level feedback. The stochasticity of transitions prevents advance determination of which trajectory (and thus which part of the space) will be realized, precluding localized Bellman operator estimation. In addition, standard elliptic exploration bonuses cannot be computed causally; they require knowing the whole trajectory before the episode begins. The work of[Vakili and Olkhovskaya, 2023]最近声称非常令人印象深刻recently claimed a very impressive顺序最优order-optimal在行动层面的反馈下感到遗憾；然而，regret under action-level feedback; however,Maran et al. Namely, space localization methods aim to obtain tighter confidence bounds by constructing estimators that use only samples from a small subset of the domain. The issue with this method in value iteration is that while we can control the state-action pair(xih,aih)(x^{h}_{i},a^{h}_{i})，没有办法定位下一个过渡状态, there is no way to localize the next transition statexih+1x^{h+1}_{i}。这在价值迭代中至关重要，因为. Our work avoids this issue by using uniform covering bounds; that is, we do not localize the value function to any part of the domain. 这种计算保证应该与现有的无遗憾算法进行对比 内核和平滑 MDP。 KOVI等算法This computational guarantee should be contrasted with existing no-regret algorithms for kernel and smooth MDPs. Algorithms such as KOVI[Yang et al., 2020]在计算上是高效的 通常的 kernel-LSVI 意义，但是对于这里考虑的硬低平滑 Matérn 机制来说，它们的遗憾保证并不是次线性的。另一方面，最近的 smooth-MDP 在这种通用性水平上获得无悔保证的算法依赖于多项式实现尚不清楚的优化预言。在 特别是，are computationally efficient in the usual kernel-LSVI sense, but their regret guarantees are not sublinear for the hard low-smoothness Matérn regimes considered here. On the other hand, the recent smooth-MDP algorithms that obtain no-regret guarantees at this level of generality rely on optimization oracles for which a polynomial implementation is unclear. NeurIPS 论文清单NeurIPS Paper Checklist

  1. 1.

    索赔Claims

  2. 问题：摘要和引言中提出的主要主张是否准确反映了论文的贡献和范围？Question: Do the main claims made in the abstract and introduction accurately reflect the paper’s contributions and scope?

  3. 答：Answer:[是][Yes]

  4. 理由：摘要和引言中陈述的所有权利要求均在正文中得到进一步发展，并在附录中得到证明。Justification: All the claims stated in the abstract and introduction are further developed in the main text and proven in the Appendix.

  5. 指南：Guidelines:

    • •

      答案The answer[不适用][N/A]意味着摘要和引言不包括论文中提出的权利要求。means that the abstract and introduction do not include the claims made in the paper.

    • •

      摘要和/或引言应清楚地说明所提出的主张，包括论文中所做的贡献以及重要的假设和限制。一个The abstract and/or introduction should clearly state the claims made, including the contributions made in the paper and important assumptions and limitations. A[否][No] or [不适用][N/A]审稿人不会很好地理解这个问题的答案。answer to this question will not be perceived well by the reviewers.

    • •

      所提出的主张应与理论和实验结果相匹配，并反映结果可以在多大程度上推广到其他设置。The claims made should match theoretical and experimental results, and reflect how much the results can be expected to generalize to other settings.

    • •

      只要论文明确没有实现这些目标，就可以将理想目标作为动机。It is fine to include aspirational goals as motivation as long as it is clear that these goals are not attained by the paper.

  6. 2.

    局限性Limitations

  7. 问题：本文是否讨论了作者所做工作的局限性？Question: Does the paper discuss the limitations of the work performed by the authors?

  8. 答：Answer:[是][Yes]

  9. 理由：我们工作的局限性在结论部分以及主要结果和相关工作部分中提到。Justification: The limitations of our work are mentioned in the conclusion section and through out the main result and related works section.

  10. 指南：Guidelines:

    • •

      答案The answer[不适用][N/A]表示论文没有限制，而答案means that the paper has no limitation while the answer[否][No]意味着论文有局限性，但论文中没有讨论这些局限性。means that the paper has limitations, but those are not discussed in the paper.

    • •

      鼓励作者在论文中创建一个单独的“局限性”部分。The authors are encouraged to create a separate “Limitations” section in their paper.

    • •

      论文应指出任何强有力的假设以及结果对违反这些假设的鲁棒性如何（例如，独立假设、无噪声设置、模型良好规范、仅在局部保持的渐近近似）。作者应该反思这些假设在实践中可能如何被违反以及会产生什么影响。The paper should point out any strong assumptions and how robust the results are to violations of these assumptions (e.g., independence assumptions, noiseless settings, model well-specification, asymptotic approximations only holding locally). The authors should reflect on how these assumptions might be violated in practice and what the implications would be.

    • •

      作者应该反思所提出的主张的范围，例如，如果该方法仅在几个数据集或几次运行中进行了测试。一般来说，实证结果通常取决于隐含的假设，这些假设应该被阐明。The authors should reflect on the scope of the claims made, e.g., if the approach was only tested on a few datasets or with a few runs. In general, empirical results often depend on implicit assumptions, which should be articulated.

    • •

      作者应该反思影响该方法性能的因素。例如，当图像分辨率较低或在低光照条件下拍摄图像时，面部识别算法可能表现不佳。或者，语音转文本系统可能无法可靠地用于为在线讲座提供隐藏式字幕，因为它无法处理技术术语。The authors should reflect on the factors that influence the performance of the approach. For example, a facial recognition algorithm may perform poorly when image resolution is low or images are taken in low lighting. Or a speech-to-text system might not be used reliably to provide closed captions for online lectures because it fails to handle technical jargon.

    • •

      作者应该讨论所提出算法的计算效率以及它们如何随着数据集大小进行扩展。The authors should discuss the computational efficiency of the proposed algorithms and how they scale with dataset size.

    • •

      如果适用，作者应该讨论他们解决隐私和公平问题的方法可能存在的局限性。If applicable, the authors should discuss possible limitations of their approach to address problems of privacy and fairness.

    • •

      虽然作者可能担心审稿人可能会利用对限制的完全诚实作为拒绝的理由，但更糟糕的结果可能是审稿人发现论文中未承认的限制。作者应该运用他们的最佳判断，并认识到有利于透明度的个人行动在制定维护社区完整性的规范方面发挥着重要作用。将特别指示审稿人不要惩罚有关限制的诚实行为。While the authors might fear that complete honesty about limitations might be used by reviewers as grounds for rejection, a worse outcome might be that reviewers discover limitations that aren’t acknowledged in the paper. The authors should use their best judgment and recognize that individual actions in favor of transparency play an important role in developing norms that preserve the integrity of the community. Reviewers will be specifically instructed to not penalize honesty concerning limitations.

  11. 3.

    理论假设和证明Theory assumptions and proofs

  12. 问题：对于每个理论结果，论文是否提供了全套假设和完整（且正确）的证明？Question: For each theoretical result, does the paper provide the full set of assumptions and a complete (and correct) proof?

  13. 答：Answer:[是][Yes]

  14. 理由：所有理论陈述均在附录中得到证明。Justification: All theoretical statements are proven in the appendix.

  15. 指南：Guidelines:

    • •

      答案The answer[不适用][N/A]意味着该论文不包含理论结果。means that the paper does not include theoretical results.

    • •

      论文中的所有定理、公式和证明都应编号并交叉引用。All the theorems, formulas, and proofs in the paper should be numbered and cross-referenced.

    • •

      所有假设都应在任何定理的陈述中清楚地陈述或引用。All assumptions should be clearly stated or referenced in the statement of any theorems.

    • •

      证明可以出现在主论文或补充材料中，但如果它们出现在补充材料中，则鼓励作者提供简短的证明草图以提供直觉。The proofs can either appear in the main paper or the supplemental material, but if they appear in the supplemental material, the authors are encouraged to provide a short proof sketch to provide intuition.

    • •

      相反，论文核心中提供的任何非正式证明都应由附录或补充材料中提供的正式证明进行补充。Inversely, any informal proof provided in the core of the paper should be complemented by formal proofs provided in appendix or supplemental material.

    • •

      应正确引用证明所依赖的定理和引理。Theorems and Lemmas that the proof relies upon should be properly referenced.

  16. 4.

    实验结果重现性Experimental result reproducibility

  17. 问：论文是否充分披露了重现论文主要实验结果所需的所有信息，并达到影响论文主要主张和/或结论的程度（无论是否提供代码和数据）？Question: Does the paper fully disclose all the information needed to reproduce the main experimental results of the paper to the extent that it affects the main claims and/or conclusions of the paper (regardless of whether the code and data are provided or not)?

  18. 答：Answer:[是][Yes]

  19. 理由：实验在第 2 节中有详细描述。Justification: The experiments are described in detail in Sec.8.

  20. 指南：Guidelines:

    • •

      答案The answer[不适用][N/A]意味着该论文不包含实验。means that the paper does not include experiments.

    • •

      如果论文包含实验，If the paper includes experiments, a[否][No]审稿人不会很好地理解这个问题的答案：无论是否提供代码和数据，使论文具有可重复性很重要。answer to this question will not be perceived well by the reviewers: Making the paper reproducible is important, regardless of whether the code and data are provided or not.

    • •

      如果贡献的是数据集和/或模型，作者应描述为使其结果可重现或可验证而采取的步骤。If the contribution is a dataset and/or model, the authors should describe the steps taken to make their results reproducible or verifiable.

    • •

      根据贡献，可以通过多种方式实现可重复性。例如，如果贡献是一种新颖的架构，充分描述该架构可能就足够了，或者如果贡献是一个特定的模型和实证评估，则可能有必要让其他人能够使用相同的数据集复制该模型，或者提供对该模型的访问。一般来说。发布代码和数据通常是实现这一目标的一种好方法，但也可以通过详细说明如何复制结果、访问托管模型（例如，在大型语言模型的情况下）、发布模型检查点或适合所执行的研究的其他方式来提供可重复性。Depending on the contribution, reproducibility can be accomplished in various ways. For example, if the contribution is a novel architecture, describing the architecture fully might suffice, or if the contribution is a specific model and empirical evaluation, it may be necessary to either make it possible for others to replicate the model with the same dataset, or provide access to the model. In general. releasing code and data is often one good way to accomplish this, but reproducibility can also be provided via detailed instructions for how to replicate the results, access to a hosted model (e.g., in the case of a large language model), releasing of a model checkpoint, or other means that are appropriate to the research performed.

    • •

      虽然 NeurIPS 不要求发布代码，但会议确实要求所有提交内容提供一些合理的可重复性途径，这可能取决于贡献的性质。例如While NeurIPS does not require releasing code, the conference does require all submissions to provide some reasonable avenue for reproducibility, which may depend on the nature of the contribution. For example

      1. (一)(a)

        如果贡献主要是一个新算法，论文应该明确如何重现该算法。If the contribution is primarily a new algorithm, the paper should make it clear how to reproduce that algorithm.

      2. (二)(b)

        如果贡献主要是一个新的模型架构，那么论文应该清晰、完整地描述该架构。If the contribution is primarily a new model architecture, the paper should describe the architecture clearly and fully.

      3. (三)(c)

        如果贡献的是一个新模型（例如，一个大型语言模型），那么应该有一种方法来访问该模型以重现结果，或者一种重现模型的方法（例如，使用开源数据集或如何构建数据集的说明）。If the contribution is a new model (e.g., a large language model), then there should either be a way to access this model for reproducing the results or a way to reproduce the model (e.g., with an open-source dataset or instructions for how to construct the dataset).

      4. (四)(d)

        我们认识到，在某些情况下，再现性可能很棘手，在这种情况下，欢迎作者描述他们提供再现性的特定方式。在闭源模型的情况下，对模型的访问可能会受到某种方式的限制（例如，注册用户），但其他研究人员应该有可能有某种途径来复制或验证结果。We recognize that reproducibility may be tricky in some cases, in which case authors are welcome to describe the particular way they provide for reproducibility. In the case of closed-source models, it may be that access to the model is limited in some way (e.g., to registered users), but it should be possible for other researchers to have some path to reproducing or verifying the results.

  21. 5.

    开放数据和代码的访问Open access to data and code

  22. 问题：论文是否提供对数据和代码的开放访问，并提供足够的说明来忠实地再现主要实验结果，如补充材料中所述？Question: Does the paper provide open access to the data and code, with sufficient instructions to faithfully reproduce the main experimental results, as described in supplemental material?

      虽然我们鼓励发布代码和数据，但我们知道这可能是不可能的，所以While we encourage the release of code and data, we understand that this might not be possible, so[否][No]是一个可以接受的答案。论文不能仅仅因为不包含代码而被拒绝，除非这是贡献的核心（例如，对于新的开源基准）。is an acceptable answer. Papers cannot be rejected simply for not including code, unless this is central to the contribution (e.g., for a new open-source benchmark).

      说明应包含运行以重现结果所需的确切命令和环境。请参阅 NeurIPS 代码和数据提交指南（The instructions should contain the exact command and environment needed to run to reproduce the results. See the NeurIPS code and data submission guidelines (https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy）了解更多详情。) for more details.

      作者应提供数据访问和准备的说明，包括如何访问原始数据、预处理数据、中间数据和生成数据等。The authors should provide instructions on data access and preparation, including how to access the raw data, preprocessed data, intermediate data, and generated data, etc.

If only a subset of experiments are reproducible, they should state which ones are omitted from the script and why.

    • •

      在提交时，为了保持匿名，作者应发布匿名版本（如果适用）。At submission time, to preserve anonymity, the authors should release anonymized versions (if applicable).

      建议在补充材料（附加到论文中）中提供尽可能多的信息，但允许包含数据和代码的 URL。Providing as much information as possible in supplemental material (appended to the paper) is recommended, but including URLs to data and code is permitted.

      实验设置应在论文的核心部分详细介绍，以便欣赏结果并理解结果。The experimental setting should be presented in the core of the paper to a level of detail that is necessary to appreciate the results and make sense of them.

      应解释计算误差线的方法（封闭式公式、调用库函数、引导程序等）The method for calculating the error bars should be explained (closed form formula, call to a library function, bootstrap, etc.)

    更广泛的影响Broader impacts

  47. 问题：本文是否讨论了所开展工作的潜在积极社会影响和消极社会影响？Question: Does the paper discuss both potential positive societal impacts and negative societal impacts of the work performed?

  48. 答：Answer:[不适用][N/A]

  49. 理由：这是一篇理论论文。Justification: It is a theoretical paper.

  50. 指南：Guidelines:

    • •

      答案The answer[不适用][N/A]意味着所做的工作不会产生社会影响。means that there is no societal impact of the work performed.

    • •

      如果作者回答If the authors answer[不适用][N/A] or [否][No]，他们应该解释为什么他们的工作没有社会影响，或者为什么论文没有解决社会影响。, they should explain why their work has no societal impact or why the paper does not address societal impact.

    • •

      负面社会影响的例子包括潜在的恶意或非预期用途（例如，虚假信息、生成虚假个人资料、监视）、公平性考虑（例如，部署可能做出不公平地影响特定群体的决策的技术）、隐私考虑和安全考虑。Examples of negative societal impacts include potential malicious or unintended uses (e.g., disinformation, generating fake profiles, surveillance), fairness considerations (e.g., deployment of technologies that could make decisions that unfairly impact specific groups), privacy considerations, and security considerations.

    • •

      会议预计许多论文将是基础研究，不与特定应用程序相关，更不用说部署了。然而，如果存在任何负面应用的直接路径，作者应该指出。例如，可以合理地指出，生成模型质量的改进可用于生成虚假信息的 Deepfakes。另一方面，无需指出优化神经网络的通用算法可以使人们能够更快地训练生成 Deepfakes 的模型。The conference expects that many papers will be foundational research and not tied to particular applications, let alone deployments. However, if there is a direct path to any negative applications, the authors should point it out. For example, it is legitimate to point out that an improvement in the quality of generative models could be used to generate Deepfakes for disinformation. On the other hand, it is not needed to point out that a generic algorithm for optimizing neural networks could enable people to train models that generate Deepfakes faster.

    • •

      作者应考虑当技术按预期使用并正常运行时可能出现的危害、当技术按预期使用但给出不正确的结果时可能出现的危害、以及（有意或无意）滥用技术而造成的危害。The authors should consider possible harms that could arise when the technology is being used as intended and functioning correctly, harms that could arise when the technology is being used as intended but gives incorrect results, and harms following from (intentional or unintentional) misuse of the technology.

    • •

      如果存在负面社会影响，作者还可以讨论可能的缓解策略（例如，模型的门控发布、除了攻击之外还提供防御、监控滥用的机制、监控系统如何随着时间的推移从反馈中学习的机制、提高机器学习的效率和可访问性）。If there are negative societal impacts, the authors could also discuss possible mitigation strategies (e.g., gated release of models, providing defenses in addition to attacks, mechanisms for monitoring misuse, mechanisms to monitor how a system learns from feedback over time, improving the efficiency and accessibility of ML).
